UPDATED interpretation. Own enrichment rank 62 (t=8.74, FDR=2.1e-14) - real and significant despite ranking outside top-10; massively significant against EVERY gray matter domain tested (t=14.7-22.8 vs vInhib/vL2/vL5a/vL5b/vL6/vLD). MeanRatio rank 1, but a very weak ratio (~1.07x) since its closest competitor is vWMd - meaning GFAP alone does not distinguish vWMpv from vWMuf/vWMd specifically. VCAN (versican, a glial-limiting-membrane/perivascular ECM component) shows the same pattern as a second, independent corroborating gene (own enrichment rank 77; significant vs vL5b/vL6/vLD). Together with cross-platform registration - the Xenium GL cluster (SOX9/AQP4/PAX6/GJA1) matches BOTH vL1 (glia limitans superficialis) and vWMpv (glia limitans perivascularis) - this supports a genuine glia-limitans-perivascularis signature in this domain, i.e. astrocyte end-feet on vessels penetrating through white matter, NOT proximity to the large surface vessels captured by vVasc (that spatial-distance test was negative and is a separate, narrower claim)
